blocks.text: Emerging technologies nayi ya tezi se barhti technologies hain jo logon ke rehne, kaam karne, rabta karne aur masail hal karne ka tareeqa badal sakti hain.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) computer science ki shaakh hai jo machines ko aise kaam karne deti hai jin ke liye aam tor par insani zehanat chahiye, jaise seekhna, soch kar natija nikalna (reasoning), tasveerein pehchanna, baat samajhna aur faisle karna.

Internet of Things (IoT) internet se jure physical devices hain jo data jama, share aur us par amal kar sakte hain. Misalein: smart watches, smart lights, smart cameras aur zameen ki nigrani ke sensors.
Cloud computing internet par mabni services ka istemal hai jin se data store, applications chalayi aur computing wasail use kiye jate hain, sirf apne computer ya server par inhisar kiye baghair.
Blockchain record rakhne ki digital technology hai jis mein data aapas mein jure blocks mein store hota hai. Yeh aam tor par mehfooz, shaffaf aur chhed-chhaar se bache len-den ke liye use hoti hai.
Stakeholders woh log ya groups hain jin par koi technology system asar dalta hai. AI systems mein users, developers, idare, hukoomatein aur muashra stakeholders ho sakte hain.
Ethical AI ka matlab AI systems ko munsifana, shaffaf, jawabdeh, mehfooz aur zimmedarana tareeqe se banana aur use karna hai.
AI mein bias tab hota hai jab AI system biased data, kharab design ya mukhtalif groups ki na-barabar numaindagi ki wajah se na-insafi wale nataij de.
Inclusivity ka matlab technology ko aisa banana hai ke woh mukhtalif jins, saqafat, zaban, ilaqe aur pas-e-manzar ke logon ki barabar khidmat kare.
Mafadat ka takrao tab hota hai jab ek stakeholder ke maqasid ya faide doosron ke huqooq, hifazat ya mafadat par bura asar dalein.
AI governance woh qawaid, policies aur hidayat hain jo yaqeeni banati hain ke AI systems zimmedari se banaye aur use kiye jayein.
Responsible innovation (zimmedarana ijaad) aisi technology banana hai jo haqeeqi masail hal kare aur saath akhlaqiyat, hifazat, saqafat, insaf aur lambe arse ke samaji asar ka khayal rakhe.
Smart agriculture (smart zaraat) kheti behtar karne ke liye IoT, AI, cloud computing aur blockchain jaisi technologies ka istemal hai.

Technology integration mukhtalif technologies ko mila kar zyada mufeed hal banana hai. Maslan zaraat ka system data jama karne ke liye IoT, andaze ke liye AI, storage ke liye cloud computing aur mehfooz records ke liye blockchain use kar sakta hai.
Policy aur legal frameworks woh qawaid aur qawaneen hain jo batate hain ke technologies kaise banayi, use aur control ki jayein taake log, idare aur muashra mehfooz rahein.

items: AI, IoT, cloud computing aur blockchain: har ek ka kaam aur in ka milap.
Stakeholders, akhlaqi AI, bias aur inclusivity.
Pakistan ke liye smart zaraat; AI governance aur zimmedarana ijaad.
